source: Publisher documentation saved under e3/truth/docs/fresh/ (sha256 in SHA256SUMS): TPC-DS v3.2.0; LDBC SNB specification (v2.2.5-SNAPSHOT, Appendix D for the Interactive v1 legacy data sets); GTFS Schedule Reference; FAA ardata.pdf (5/8/2025); ABS ASGS Edition 3 web pages; SEC Financial Statement Data Sets; College Scorecard Field of Study documentation (October 2026) and data dictionary; EPA AirData FileFormats (v3.0.0); 2024 ACS PUMS data dictionary and Census regions and divisions; City of Chicago portal metadata (ijzp-q8t2, c7ck-438e); USDA FoodData Central download field descriptions (October 2020)
rule: Sigma* is the set of FDs that the publisher documentation implies among the attributes of each relation, projected and closed over the dropped columns, each with a verbatim quote; sure when the quoted text states it (declared key, foreign key to a declared key, an explicit one-to-one or nesting statement), unsure when it needs an inference the text does not spell out. Dependencies the documentation hints at but does not state are listed under undocumented_regularities and are not part of Sigma*. Written from the documentation alone, before any data file was opened.

instance.generator: public data fixed before download for the confirmatory evaluation, joined by fresh.py
instance.construction: ABS ASGS Edition 3 (July 2021 - June 2026) Mesh Block allocation file MB_2021_AUST.xlsx converted to CSV with its header row (368,286 Mesh Blocks per the Mesh Blocks page); single table; dropped AUS_CODE_2021 and AUS_NAME_2021 (the single code AUS and its name, constant by the documentation).

cleaning.missing_values: empty and missing references become '?', kept as a value (null = null)

truth.clause: abs_allocation-files.html, Metadata for allocation files: "MB_2021_AUST contains all Mesh Blocks within Australia and includes the following fields:" and "It also gives the area in square kilometres of the Mesh Block, based on Albers Equal Area Conic projection."; abs_mesh-blocks.html: "Land use is recorded in the Mesh Block category attribute according to the criteria below."; abs_changes-previous-edition-asgs.html (https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs/edition-3-july-2021-june-2026/main-structure-and-greater-capital-city-statistical-areas/changes-previous-edition-asgs, retrieved 2026-10-27): "In ASGS Edition 3, change flags have been included on all Main Structure and Greater Capital City Statistical boundaries as an attribute."
truth.justification: The file has one row per Mesh Block, identified by its code, and the category, change flag and label, area and LOCI URI are attributes of that Mesh Block.

audit.quote: "For example MB_2021_AUST contains all Mesh Blocks within Australia and includes the following fields:" and "It also gives the area in square kilometres of the Mesh Block, based on Albers Equal Area Conic projection." (abs_allocation-files.html, Metadata for allocation files); "The 11-digit Mesh Block code comprises: State and Territory identifier (1 digit), and a Mesh Block identifier (10 digits)." and "Land use is recorded in the Mesh Block category attribute according to the criteria below." (abs_mesh-blocks.html); "In ASGS Edition 3, change flags have been included on all Main Structure and Greater Capital City Statistical boundaries as an attribute." (abs_changes-previous-edition-asgs.html, Identifying change, Change flag descriptions)
audit.source: abs_allocation-files.html, Metadata for allocation files; abs_mesh-blocks.html; abs_changes-previous-edition-asgs.html, Identifying change, Change flag descriptions

truth.clause: abs_statistical-area-level-1.html: "Statistical Areas Level 1 (SA1s) are geographic areas built from whole Mesh Blocks."
truth.justification: SA1s are built from whole Mesh Blocks, so each Mesh Block lies in exactly one SA1.

audit.quote: "Statistical Areas Level 1 (SA1s) are geographic areas built from whole Mesh Blocks." and "There are 61,845 SA1 regions covering the whole of Australia without gaps or overlaps." (abs_statistical-area-level-1.html)

truth.clause: abs_statistical-area-level-1.html: "Whole SA1s aggregate to form Statistical Areas Level 2 (SA2s)."
truth.justification: Whole SA1s aggregate to SA2s, so each SA1 lies in exactly one SA2.

audit.quote: "Whole SA1s aggregate to form Statistical Areas Level 2 (SA2s)." and "SA1s are identified by an 11-digit fully hierarchical code, comprising the 1-digit State and Territory, and Statistical Areas Level 1-4 identifiers." (abs_statistical-area-level-1.html)

truth.clause: abs_statistical-area-level-2.html: "Whole SA2s aggregate to form Statistical Areas Level 3 (SA3s)." and "An SA2 is identifiable by a 9-digit fully hierarchical code comprising the 1-digit State or Territory identifier, and Statistical Areas Level 2-4 identifiers."
truth.justification: The SA2 code identifies the SA2, which has one name and lies in exactly one SA3.

audit.quote: "Whole SA2s aggregate to form Statistical Areas Level 3 (SA3s)." and "An SA2 is identifiable by a 9-digit fully hierarchical code comprising the 1-digit State or Territory identifier, and Statistical Areas Level 2-4 identifiers." (abs_statistical-area-level-2.html)

truth.clause: abs_statistical-area-level-2.html, SA2 name criteria: "unique, that is not shared by any other SA2 in Australia"
truth.justification: SA2 names are unique in Australia, so the name identifies the SA2 and its code.

audit.quote: SA2 name criteria: "unique, that is not shared by any other SA2 in Australia" (abs_statistical-area-level-2.html)

truth.clause: abs_statistical-area-level-3.html: "Whole SA3s aggregate to form Statistical Areas Level 4 (SA4s)." and "SA3s are identified by 5-digit hierarchical codes."
truth.justification: The SA3 code identifies the SA3, which has one name and lies in exactly one SA4.

audit.quote: "Whole SA3s aggregate to form Statistical Areas Level 4 (SA4s)." and "SA3s are identified by 5-digit hierarchical codes. This comprises a 1-digit State or Territory identifier followed by a 2-digit SA4 identifier, unique within each State and Territory, and a 2-digit SA3 identifier, unique within each SA4." (abs_statistical-area-level-3.html)

truth.clause: abs_statistical-area-level-3.html, SA3 name criteria: "unique, that is not shared by any other SA3 in Australia"
truth.justification: SA3 names are unique in Australia.

audit.quote: SA3 name criteria: "unique, that is not shared by any other SA3 in Australia" (abs_statistical-area-level-3.html)

truth.clause: abs_statistical-area-level-4.html: "Whole SA4s aggregate to Greater Capital City Statistical Areas and States and Territories." and "SA4s are identified by a 3-digit hierarchical code."
truth.justification: The SA4 code identifies the SA4, which has one name and lies in exactly one GCCSA and one State or Territory.

audit.quote: "Whole SA4s aggregate to Greater Capital City Statistical Areas and States and Territories." and "SA4s are identified by a 3-digit hierarchical code. This comprises a 1-digit State or Territory identifier, which precedes a 2-digit SA4 identifier, unique within each State and Territory." (abs_statistical-area-level-4.html); "Greater Capital City Statistical Areas (GCCSAs) are geographic areas built from Statistical Areas Level 4 (SA4s)." and "There are 16 GCCSAs covering the whole of Australia without gaps or overlaps." (abs_greater-capital-city-statistical-areas.html)

truth.clause: abs_statistical-area-level-4.html, SA4 name criteria: "unique, that is not shared by any other SA4 in Australia"
truth.justification: SA4 names are unique in Australia.

audit.quote: SA4 name criteria: "unique, that is not shared by any other SA4 in Australia" (abs_statistical-area-level-4.html)

truth.clause: abs_greater-capital-city-statistical-areas.html, GCCSA coding structure: "A GCCSA is identified by a 5-character alphanumeric code. This comprises a 1-digit State or Territory identifier followed by a 4-character GCCSA identifier that is unique within each State and Territory."
truth.justification: The GCCSA code identifies the GCCSA (hence its name) and contains the identifier of the one State or Territory it belongs to.

audit.quote: "A GCCSA is identified by a 5-character alphanumeric code. This comprises a 1-digit State or Territory identifier followed by a 4-character GCCSA identifier that is unique within each State and Territory." (abs_greater-capital-city-statistical-areas.html, GCCSA coding structure)
